name: Pet Grooming (Boutique)
tagline: A refined, boutique template for pet groomers — book online from day one.
description: An upscale, boutique pet-spa site — a warm ivory ground, a deep-plum primary and a blush accent, with an elegant serif display and calm photography. Installs a working booking flow: a real spa menu (signature groom, breed hand styling, spa add-ons, cat grooming), three master groomers you book by name, two private suites as bookable rooms, and a deposit policy. Ships as "The Groom Room".
